title: pentacalia peruviana
intro: Pentacalia peruviana, commonly known as the Peruvian pentacalia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pentacalia peruviana include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include phenolic compounds, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
